newsitem.title: UK: Leaked report shows British jobless down-newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Leaked report shows British jobless down-newspaper.

text.p: Britain's Mirror newspaper said on Wednesday it had obtained a leaked copy of official jobless figures showing a larger than expected fall of 68,200 in February.
The newspaper said the figures, due to be announced at 0930 GMT on Wednesday, showed the seasonally adjusted total down to 1,746,300, or 6.2 percent.
"The official reduction leaves 6.2 percent of the workforce on the dole -- 1,334,500 men and 411,800 women," the newspaper said.
It said it was the third time it had obtained jobless figures early in the last six months.
Economists had said they expected the figures to show a fall of some 40,000 in unemployment between January and February, below the level of most of its European neighbours.

The figures will be a welcome boost for Prime Minister John Major, who launched his re-election campaign for a May 1 poll on Monday. His ruling Conservatives are trailing the opposition Labour Party by up to 25 points in the latest opinon polls.
Major will greet the data, the latest in a long line of encouraging monthly statistics on the jobs, as further evidence that his party's economic policies are working.
